title: The role demands everything
text: {studio} offers {client} a prestige role. The director demands a visible transformation: ten kilograms lighter or heavier by the premiere.

choices.label: Agree: lose ten kilos
choices.outcome: {client} takes on the challenge. Trainers, costume fittings and strict weekly plans now rule the days.

choices.label: Agree: gain ten kilos
choices.outcome: {client} says yes. The transformation becomes the talk of the set long before a camera rolls.

choices.label: Negotiate a double and costume work
choices.outcome: The costume department finds a way. {client} is relieved, but {studio} considers the solution an expensive compromise.

choices.label: Turn down the role
choices.outcome: The role moves on. Nobody is thrilled, but the line was clear.

title: Premiere: the transformation
text: Twelve grueling weeks lie behind {client}. The premiere decides whether audience and critics see the physical transformation as a great achievement.

choices.label: See it through to the premiere
choices.outcome: The premiere becomes a triumph. The transformation earns {client} new admiration and a hefty fame boost.
choices.outcome_fail: The effort is respected, the film is not. What remains: ten lost kilos and deep exhaustion.

choices.label: Abort the transformation early
choices.outcome: {client} quits the strict program. {studio} fumes, but everyday life gets easier immediately.

choices.outcome_fail: The effort is respected, the film is not. What remains: ten extra kilos and deep exhaustion.

title: The figure in the headlines
text: A tabloid mocks {client}'s changed figure. The pictures are chosen cruelly, the headline is worse.

choices.label: Counter with a PR campaign ({money_fmt:6000})
choices.outcome: The campaign turns the tone: spite becomes a debate about role models. {client} knows who had their back.

choices.label: Sit out the talk

effects.text: The tabloids tear into {client}'s changed figure.

choices.outcome: After a few days the pictures vanish from the front page. For {client}, the mockery sits deeper.

choices.label: Stage a diet story
choices.outcome: The magazine gets training photos and an exclusive plan. The story sells — and {client} pays with strength and nerves.

choices.label: Bury the column before the print run

effects.text: One call to the print floor, one to the editor's creditor. The column never runs.

choices.outcome: The piece vanishes between edition planning and print — nobody will miss it.
choices.outcome_fail: The editor smells the intervention and runs the piece one page earlier — with relish.
